limitations: No PDF internals, live model verification, or correctness claim against potentially noisy dataset gold.
Unrecognized headline/row semantics are uncheckable, never counted as passing.
A finite unknown margin with an explanation is honest; no arbitrary percentage ceiling is imposed.
Only existing structured artifacts are eligible; missing-data exclusions are reported.
Judge sets under results/final/QA were absent in the audited snapshots.
All model calls forced fake; 47 of 199 responses include fake-model fallbacks and cannot establish live model accuracy.
Earlier diagnostic reports are superseded where their checker revisions were too strict.
The combined four-branch product has not been audited because its merge conflicts remain unresolved.
Selected structured questions covered IFC, DXF and raster. No DWG/SVG or JPEG-specific case was available in this selected corpus; ingest internals were not audited.
